The '''''Shooting Star''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Remmik Kulavinar]]. In [[44 ABY]], Kulavinar piloted [[Journalist/Legends|reporter]] [[Madhi Vaandt]] and her news crew in the ''Shooting Star'' while she was doing a segment on existing [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] practices throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] for ''[[The Perre Needmo Newshour]]''.
